notes: Game Bot V0.12 (staged, not published): Built-in pack materials (including foliage like pine bushes) auto-convert to URP Lit or Simple Lit, keeping albedo and alpha cutoff so leaves do not render white. Vague or misspelled game-chat requests (scarier, too quiet, more trees with less lag, can't see, bigger map, enemies too hard, and similar) get a concrete, game-aware proposal instead of a canned pillars list.
